name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A recipe that turns an AI coding assistant into an automated security inspector for a piece of software, and double-checks its own work before reporting problems.
buyer: A freelance security consultant or small pentest shop that wants to triple the number of codebase audits they can sell per month without hiring.
business_use_cases: A boutique security consultancy runs it as a first-pass audit before a human reviewer spends billable hours, cutting audit turnaround from a week to a day.
A SaaS company bolts it into their CI pipeline as a pre-release gate so every deploy gets an automated vulnerability sweep.
A bug bounty hunter runs it against public repos overnight to surface candidate findings to investigate by hand the next morning.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI-assisted security audit' as a fixed-price add-on service, using this skill to do the first pass and a human to verify.
Run it as a hosted CI check that companies pay per repo per month to have every PR scanned.
Charge per audit run for teams that don't want to set up the agent infrastructure themselves.

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple web form: paste a GitHub repo URL, get a PDF security report emailed to you in an hour, charge $99 per report.
